name: infographic-api
//: BL-39: type=commonjs. Without it this package inherits the root type=module, every .ts here becomes an ES module, and the only loader able to run it is tsx — which is built on esbuild and does not implement emitDecoratorMetadata. That silently disabled all DTO validation (BL-30) and leaves NestJS DI dependent on explicit @Inject tokens.
